prompt: One production UI asset: perfectly front-facing circular NavBall instrument BEZEL ONLY, matching the KSP1 STOCK approved UI reference. Moulded graphite and silver-grey physical plastic/metal game instrument housing, polished restrained thin bevel edges, subtle slotted fasteners, realistic original KSP-style late-2000s game UI. A complete circle centered in a square opaque pure black canvas, outer radius 48.5% of canvas width, inner circular hole radius 40%. Center hole and exterior pure black. Clean large opening to preserve live NavBall diameter. No globe, no text, no digits, no tick labels, no telemetry, no fixed navigation symbols, no badges or attached readout windows. Those are rendered dynamically. Keep all hardware confined to the annulus and fully visible. No Apollo brushed aluminium mounting plate, no brass, no fantasy lighting.
